attrs.evidence: INV-R6.2 placed this mechanism in "whatever plays the role of the station" and shipped a checker instead, on the reasoning that a gate running after both writes have landed is reading the crime scene. The reasoning is right and the conclusion did not follow: `git update-ref <ref> <new-oid> <old-oid>` updates a ref only after verifying it still holds the expected old OID, which is the promotion predicate exactly. scripts/factory-station.mjs is `head` / `open` / `promote --expect` / `verify` over refs/heads/invariant-canonical. INV-R8-RECOVERY was produced in an isolated worktree opened at the canonical head and promoted through the compare-and-swap; MUT-STALE-PARENT-PROMOTION advances the ref underneath a candidate and watches the promotion be refused.
attrs.gap: IT CANNOT BIND A SESSION THAT DOES NOT CALL IT, and nothing at this layer can — the canonical state is the ref, and the shared working directory remains writable by anyone. Measured during this round rather than argued: a third concurrent session rewrote mosaic/embodiment.json in the shared tree at 17:17 on 2026-08-24, twenty minutes after INV-R6.2's receipt was written. `verify --worktree` names the divergence; it does not prevent it. Multi-ref promotion would need git's `update-ref --stdin` transaction mode and one ref does not. MEASURED AGAIN, AND WORSE, AT INV-R8.1: the shared tree does not hold a stray edit, it holds a COMPLETE alternative successor. Two branches from INV-R6 — {INV-R6.1 -> INV-R6.2 -> INV-R7.1} and INV-R8-RECOVERY — each pass every gate they run, and neither is wrong about itself. That is the invariant failing in real time, in the hour after the audit that named it, and it is the sharpest available statement of why local correctness does not compose into an identified global successor. CORRECTED AT INV-R8.2, and the correction is a retraction. INV-R8.1 added the rule `a head may be amended until something consumes it` and used it five times. It is false: a successful compare-and-swap on the canonical ref is itself a publication event, so `not known to be consumed` was standing in for `known not to have been consumed`. FAC-PROMOTION-FINALITY replaces it and INC-R81-PREMATURE-PROMOTION records what it cost.
attrs.prior_art: GPT-5.6's audit of INV-R6.2, §12. git-update-ref(1); optimistic concurrency control; the compare-and-swap discipline of a distributed version-control push.
attrs.statement: A round may be promoted only by atomically advancing the canonical ref from the exact parent OID the round started from to the candidate OID. A candidate whose base has moved is refused, and must rebase, abandon, or declare an explicit merge.
